incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2912345678 - High rate of WS handshake failures observed from MeridianFinance through customer VPC gateway (prod, us-east-2). Paging oncall.
Maya Patel: on it. @Tom can you grab the gate / logs? I'll start customer comms.
Tom Nguyen: jumping in. seeing a spike in TLS handshake errors followed by repeated client reconnects. sample log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T17:20:12Z gateway[appgw-vpc-12]: conn_id=0x7f3 tls_handshake_error: alert handshake_failure from 10.8.4.23
2026-03-15T17:20:12Z gateway[appgw-vpc-12]: client_reconnect ip=10.8.4.23 tenant=meridian-finance stream_id=821
```
Tom Nguyen: also seeing a pattern where app gateway retries are configured on customer side, causing connection storms when backend delays ~1-2s.
Sasha Rivera: confirmed. metrics show 5x increase in new ws sessions/minute for tenant meridian-finance starting 17:19:30 UTC. Backend queueing on dedicated pool 'ded-prod-4' correlates.
Carlos Kim: possible root cause: a sudden colliding rollback on customer app causing short bursts of reconnects + gateway retry policy. Also noticed ephemeral spikes in KV cache misses leading to slightly longer initial tokenization times.
Maya Patel: impact? are other tenants affected?
Tom Nguyen: noisy but bounded to meridian-finance connections. We do see increased CPU on ded-prod-4 but no cross-tenant throttles yet. isolation intact.
Meredith (Meridian SRE): we pushed a canary deploy around 17:18 for the websocket client lib. Rolling back now. Meridian seeing ~20% of their user sessions impacted (timeouts/reconnect loops). We're pausing retries on our side.
Sasha Rivera: good call. immediate mitigations we can do from infra side:
- enable per-tenant connection pacing on appgw (rate limit new WS handshakes)
- temporarily route meridian to a standby dedicated pool with extra headroom
- adjust gateway idle/timeouts and disable server-initiated retries
Maya Patel: prioritize 1 and 2. Tom, can you push the routing change? Sasha, can you flip the rate limit?
Tom Nguyen: preparing route change. will move tenant meridian-finance -> ded-prod-standby-2 and set concurrency cap for that pool.
Sasha Rivera: applying pacing now: `gateway.per_tenant.new_conn_limit=10/30s` for tenant meridian-finance. patch applied to appgw-vpc-12, rolling to other nodes.
Carlos Kim: also bumping `backend.sso_idle_timeout` to 45s on standby pool to avoid premature disconnect during handshake.
Meredith (Meridian SRE): thanks — after we roll back client canary, we'll hold off aggressive reconnects. We'll confirm once our telemetry shows stable handshake success.
Maya Patel: communication: Meredith, I'll send a short status update to your ops channel: "We see handshake failures; routing you to standby pool; pacing enabled; work with your team to rollback client canary; monitoring for stabilization." Anything to add?
Meredith (Meridian SRE): add to ask: hold off retries for 90s and share client logs if failures persist.
oncall-rotation-bot: Maya Patel acknowledged the incident. Next handoff scheduled in 2h. Reminder: file incident summar y once mitigated.
Tom Nguyen: route switch done at 17:24:05 UTC. live verification: new connections to ded-prod-standby-2 stable, handshake success ratio improved from 68% -> 97% in first 90s.
Sasha Rivera: pacing logs show new_conn spikes flattened. sample:
```
[17:24:40] tenant=meridian-finance new_conn=9 rate_limit=10
[17:24:50] tenant=meridian-finance new_conn=3 rate_limit=10
```
Carlos Kim: CPU on ded-prod-4 falling back to baseline, standby pool at 42% utilization. No cross-tenant spillover.
Meredith (Meridian SRE): we rolled back canary at 17:25:12. client retries paused. telemetry now stable, handshake success consistently >99%.
Maya Patel: excellent. timeline for followups:
- Sasha to keep pacing for 30 more mins then gradually relax to baseline
- Tom to leave meridian on standby pool for 1 hour then monitor before moving back
- Carlos to open postmortem draft and capture metrics
- Meredith to confirm when they fully ramp users back
Sasha Rivera: will keep pacing for 45 minutes and post metrics in thread.
Tom Nguyen: will not re-route back until green from Meredith + steady 10min success window.
Carlos Kim: created postmortem draft: `PM-2912345678-keen` and assigned to me + Maya + Meredith. adding perf graphs.
Meredith (Meridian SRE): thanks everyone. appreciate the quick fallback. we'll follow up with customer-facing summary.
Maya Patel: OK marking incident as "mitigated" for paging. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. great job :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2912345678 status: MITIGATED (paging cleared). Incident owners: Carlos Kim, Maya Patel. Please file final incident report within 72h.
